test_title: SSC CHSL 2025 Tier-1 (Held On: 25 Nov, 2025 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: 5 persons A, B, C, D and E are sitting around a circular table facing towards the centre (not necessarily in the same order). B is sitting second to the right of D. A is sitting second to the right of B. C is not an immediate neighbour of A. Who is to the immediate right of A?
solution:
Given: 5 persons A, B, C, D and E are sitting around a circular table facing towards the centre (not necessarily in the same order).

B is sitting second to the right of D.

A is sitting second to the right of B.

C is not an immediate neighbour of A.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/a3655d6854d594a188bec63e3228958dbaf48a295fb9e345fc2370c04a7fe0a6.png] [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/9ab9f335c3599c173f639742fd65dd24e8cbb50a7101d8fdf52d32e9d649c66a.png] 

And E sits at the remaining place.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/b628d42bfc85be51b455d461456614c15196bb1fe7f77b6b1fd120c887fa103c.png] [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/0cfcb52fd2f18fcd917e0a438a96c867e23c9506bdd809af80f9997174107399.png] 

So, D is the immediate right of A.

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 4".
